| Kind | Name | Direction | Sensitive | Compression | Datagram | Required layout |
| ---: | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `0x0000` | `WATCH` | `client_to_server` | `allowed` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | StateWatch; ResultPrefix + StateWatchResult |
| `0x0001` | `UNWATCH` | `client_to_server` | `allowed` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | subscription_id:u32; ResultPrefix |
| `0x0002` | `DISCONNECT` | `client_to_server` | `required` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | session_id:[u8;16],operation_id:[u8;16],reason:string_u32; ResultPrefix |

Every Request kind has a correlated Result with the same family and kind.

### Events

| Kind | Name | Direction | Sensitive | Compression | Datagram | Required layout |
| ---: | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `0x0000` | `STATE` | `server_to_client` | `required` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | StateEvent<ClientRecord> |
| `0x0001` | `STATE_ACK` | `client_to_server` | `allowed` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | StateAck |

### Limits

| Tag | Name | Width | Required | Hard minimum | Hard maximum |
| ---: | --- | ---: | --- | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | `MAX_PUBLISHED_CLIENTS` | 4 | true | 1 | 4096 |
| 2 | `MAX_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTIONS` | 4 | true | 1 | 4096 |

### Shared types

| Name | Required layout |
| --- | --- |
| `client_record` | session_id:[u8;16],client_instance:[u8;16],connected_server_ns:u64,idle_ns:u64,bytes_received:u64,bytes_sent:u64,name:string_u16,release:string_u16,label:string_u16,origin:typed_record,Extensions |
| `origin_unix` | peer_pid:u32,peer_uid:u32,peer_gid:u32,socket_path:bytes_u32 |
| `origin_ssh` | remote_address:string_u16,username:string_u16 |
| `origin_edge` | subject:string_u16,issuer:string_u16 |
| `origin_relay` | route_handle:u64,generation:u64,depth:u16,reserved:u16=0 |
| `origin_webrtc` | peer_id:string_u16 |
| `origin_extension` | extension_id:u64,definition_revision:u64,attempt:u64,task_id:u32,name:string_u16 |
| `active_subscriptions` | terminal_count:u16,surface_count:u16,aux_count:u16,reserved:u16=0; repeated terminal_handle:u64,view_id:u32,rows:u16,cols:u16; repeated surface_handle:u64,view_id:u32,width:u32,height:u32,scale_120:u16,reserved:u16=0; repeated family:u16,reserved:u16=0,subscription_id:u32,resource_handle:u64; each section strictly key-sorted |
| `bandwidth_rates` | ClientRecord/ClientPatch extension tag 2 exact value received_bytes_per_second:u64,sent_bytes_per_second:u64,sample_window_ns:u64; sample_window_ns is nonzero; cumulative bytes_received/bytes_sent remain required in ClientRecord |
| `auxiliary_subscription_details` | ClientRecord/ClientPatch extension tag 3 exact value count:u16,reserved:u16=0; repeated family:u16,state_watch_flags:u16,subscription_id:u32,request_flags:u32,resource:bytes_u16; entries strictly sorted by family then subscription_id; entries are an optional diagnostic refinement of matching active_subscriptions auxiliary entries; resource is the family-specific resource identity (the namespace prefix for KV), request_flags are family-specific, and state_watch_flags use StateWatch flags |
| `family_limits` | ordered optional extensions: tag 1 max published client records:u32, tag 2 max active subscriptions represented per client:u32; both tags are present in a selected family descriptor |

### Shared types

| Name | Required layout |
| --- | --- |
| `inline_item` | mime:string_u16,data:bytes_u32; MIME nonempty and at most 255 bytes, entries strictly ordered by MIME, total encoded item bytes at most 32768 |
| `upload_item` | mime:string_u16,byte_len:u64,content_hash:[u8;32],initial_receive_credit:u64; entries strictly ordered by MIME |
| `drag_item` | name:string_u16,mime_count:u16,repeated mime:string_u16; name is at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes and may be empty to mean UNKNOWN until DRAG_DROP; MIME values nonempty, unique, and strictly ordered |
| `drag_drop_items_extension` | required extension tag 1 value item_count:u16,repeated name:string_u16,selected_mime:string_u16; count 1..256 must equal the current drag item count, each name is at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes and each selected MIME is nonempty, at most 255 UTF-8 bytes, and present in that item's offer; the server fetches exactly one body per item in index order and applies all final names and bodies atomically before the drop |
| `selection_record` | slot:u8,owner_kind:u8,reserved:u16=0,owner_handle:u64,revision:u64,mime_count:u16,repeated mime:string_u16,Extensions |
| `drag_record` | drag_handle:u64,revision:u64,owner_session:[u8;16],source_actions:u16,selected_action:u16,target_surface:u64,item_count:u16,repeated name:string_u16,mime_count:u16,repeated mime:string_u16,Extensions |
| `state_entity_body` | entity_kind:u16,reserved:u16=0; ADD/REPLACE complete selection_record or drag_record; PATCH entity key then Extensions; REMOVE slot:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,revision:u64 or drag_handle:u64,revision:u64 |
| `family_limits` | ordered optional extensions: tags 1..7 encode max inline bytes:u32,items:u32,MIME bytes:u32,item name bytes:u32,active drags/session:u32,stages/session:u32,staged bytes/stage:u64; all tags are present in a selected family descriptor |

| `0x0007` | `FETCH` | `client_to_server` | `required` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | repository_handle:u64,operation_id:[u8;16],flags:u16,refspec_count:u16,timeout_ms:u32,remote:bytes_u16,repeated refspec:bytes_u16,Extensions; ResultPrefix + repository_revision:u64,result_count:u16,reserved:u16=0,repeated result:bytes_u32 containing FetchRefResult,Extensions |

Every Request kind has a correlated Result with the same family and kind.

### Events

| Kind | Name | Direction | Sensitive | Compression | Datagram | Required layout |
| ---: | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `0x0000` | `STATE` | `server_to_client` | `required` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | StateEvent<EntityRecord\|EntityPatch\|RemovedEntity> |
| `0x0001` | `STATE_ACK` | `client_to_server` | `allowed` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | StateAck |
| `0x0002` | `QUERY_STATE` | `server_to_client` | `required` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | query_subscription_id:u32,event:bytes_u32 containing StateEvent<WatchedQueryValue>; outer ID is nonzero and MUST equal event.subscription_id; SNAPSHOT_RECORDS has exactly one ADD record and DELTA exactly one REPLACE record, each body is a WatchedQueryValue; marker phases have no records; Transfer delivery is forbidden because StateWatch credit accounts the complete event |
| `0x0003` | `QUERY_STATE_ACK` | `client_to_server` | `allowed` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | StateAck; subscription_id is the same ID carried by both QUERY_STATE outer prefix and inner StateEvent, allocated by WATCH_QUERY |
| `0x0004` | `PROGRESS` | `server_to_client` | `required` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | operation_id:[u8;16],phase:u8,flags:u8,reserved:u16=0,current:u64,total:u64,message:string_u16 |
| `0x0005` | `CLOSED` | `server_to_client` | `required` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | repository_handle:u64,repository_revision:u64,reason:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,detail:string_u16; terminal server-side lifecycle notification; clients invalidate the repository, its watches, and its watched queries before dispatching the event |

### Limits

| Tag | Name | Width | Required | Hard minimum | Hard maximum |
| ---: | --- | ---: | --- | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | `MAX_REPOSITORIES_PER_SESSION` | 4 | true | 1 | 64 |
| 2 | `MAX_WATCHES_PER_REPOSITORY` | 4 | true | 1 | 32 |
| 3 | `MAX_WATCHED_QUERIES_PER_REPOSITORY` | 4 | true | 1 | 16 |
| 4 | `MAX_QUERY_RECORDS` | 4 | true | 1 | 4096 |
| 5 | `MAX_QUERY_BYTES` | 4 | true | 1 | 4194304 |
| 6 | `MAX_CURSOR_BYTES` | 4 | true | 1 | 4096 |
| 7 | `MAX_SPEC_BYTES` | 4 | true | 1 | 4096 |
| 8 | `MAX_INLINE_BYTES` | 4 | true | 1 | 32768 |
| 9 | `MAX_CONCURRENT_QUERIES` | 4 | true | 1 | 8 |
| 10 | `MAX_CONCURRENT_FETCHES` | 4 | true | 1 | 4 |

### Shared types

| Name | Required layout |
| --- | --- |
| `object_id` | algorithm:u8,byte_len:u8,reserved:u16=0,bytes:[u8;byte_len]; SHA1 requires 20 bytes and SHA256 requires 32 bytes; zero bytes are not a sentinel |
| `repository_source` | kind:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0; PLATFORM_PATH path:bytes_u32 raw platform bytes; FS root_handle:u64,path:bytes_u32 containing FS WirePath; SUBMODULE parent_repository:u64,path:bytes_u32 containing non-root FS WirePath; TERMINAL_CWD terminal_handle:u64,suffix:bytes_u32 containing relative FS WirePath, resolved atomically from that terminal's live cwd |
| `watch_options` | StateWatch Extensions: optional tag WATCH_REFS_SETTLE_MS_EXTENSION value u16 milliseconds (0 server default), optional tag WATCH_STATUS_SETTLE_MS_EXTENSION value u16 milliseconds (0 server default), optional tag WATCH_REF_PREFIXES_EXTENSION value count:u16 followed by unique strictly raw-byte-ascending prefix:bytes_u16 entries; empty/absent prefix list means every ref |
| `watch_status_selection` | Additional optional Git WATCH StateWatch extension: tag WATCH_STATUS_SELECTION_EXTENSION, REQUIRED clear, value exactly one u8 of flags admitting WATCH_STATUS_UNTRACKED and WATCH_STATUS_IGNORED in addition to tracked status; unknown bits are invalid and IGNORED requires UNTRACKED, so valid values are 0, 1, and 3. Absence admits both classes for compatibility; selection only applies with the WATCH_STATUS dataset and is enforced before collection budgets. Older servers may ignore this optional extension |
| `query_endpoint` | kind:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,object_present:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,optional object:ObjectId; COMMIT,TREE,MERGE_BASE require object; EMPTY,INDEX,WORKTREE forbid object; MERGE_BASE is valid only as the left endpoint |
| `query_cursor` | empty bytes mean START; otherwise kind:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0 and variant body: LOG_FRONTIER count:u16,reserved:u16=0,repeated ObjectId; PATH path:bytes_u32 containing FS WirePath; PLATFORM_PATH path:bytes_u32 raw platform bytes; PATCH path:bytes_u32 containing FS WirePath,position:u64; POSITION position:u64. Cursors are emitted by the server and replayed unchanged, but their exact form permits faithful protocol adaptation |
| `query_body` | kind:u16,flags:u16=0,variant body; RESOLVE spec:bytes_u16; MERGE_BASE object_count:u16,reserved:u16=0,repeated ordered ObjectId where 2 <= object_count <= MAX_QUERY_ENDPOINTS and the result is the best common ancestor of the complete set rather than an associative pairwise reduction; LOG query_flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,spec:bytes_u16,tip_count:u16,hide_count:u16,repeated tips:ObjectId,repeated hides:ObjectId,path:bytes_u32 empty or FS WirePath, where nonempty spec forbids explicit tips/hides and empty spec with no tips means HEAD; TREE tree:ObjectId,path:bytes_u32 FS WirePath; BLOB query_flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,object:ObjectId,path:bytes_u32 empty or FS WirePath,offset:u64,max_bytes:u32; DIFF query_flags:u16,rename_threshold:u8,reserved:u8=0,left:QueryEndpoint,right:QueryEndpoint,path:bytes_u32 empty or FS WirePath; PATCH query_flags:u16,context_lines:u8,rename_threshold:u8,max_bytes:u32,left:QueryEndpoint,right:QueryEndpoint,path:bytes_u32 empty or FS WirePath and returns the patch transforming left into right; INDEX query_flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,path:bytes_u32 empty or FS WirePath; DISCOVER query_flags:u16,max_depth:u16,source:bytes_u32 containing RepositorySource; BLAME query_flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,object:ObjectId,path:bytes_u32 FS WirePath,start_line:u32 one-based,line_count:u32 where zero means through end; REFLOG query_flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,name:bytes_u16 empty meaning HEAD; WORKTREES empty |
| `typed_query_record` | record_len:u32,record_kind:u16,record_flags:u16,body; length includes kind and flags; flag bit0 REQUIRED; known bodies are ObjectRecord, CommitRecord, TreeEntryRecord, ContentRecord, DiffRecord, IndexEntryRecord, DiscoveryRecord, BlameRecord, ReflogRecord, WorktreeRecord, LogPathRecord, PatchFileRecord, PatchRowRecord, PatchGapRecord, PatchBaseRecord; unknown optional records are skipped and unknown required records fail the containing operation |
| `object_record` | role:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,object:ObjectId; RESOLVE emits TIP then HIDE records preserving specification order, MERGE_BASE emits RESULT |
| `query_page` | next_cursor:bytes_u16 containing QueryCursor,total_hint:u64,flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,delivery:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0; MORE is set exactly when next_cursor is nonempty; INLINE record_count:u16,reserved:u16=0,record_stream:bytes_u32; TRANSFER descriptor:bytes_u32 containing sensitive server-to-client MESSAGE TransferDescriptor with content kind QUERY_CONTENT_KIND; Extensions; ordinary QUERY permits either delivery, watched QUERY_STATE requires INLINE. For LOG, next_cursor is LOG_FRONTIER and preserves the frontier exactly; watched LOG pages are complete replacements whose MORE flag/frontier are interpreted identically to one-shot LOG pages |
| `watched_query_value` | query_status:u16 using Core status codes,reserved:u16=0,detail:string_u32,page:bytes_u32 empty or containing QueryPage; OK requires empty detail and one INLINE page; non-OK requires nonempty detail and an empty page; a later REPLACE with OK represents recovery without terminating the subscription |
| `commit_record` | flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,object:ObjectId,tree:ObjectId,parent_count:u16,reserved:u16=0,repeated parent:ObjectId,authored_unix_seconds:i64,author_timezone_minutes:i16,committed_unix_seconds:i64,committer_timezone_minutes:i16,author_name:bytes_u16,author_email:bytes_u16,committer_name:bytes_u16,committer_email:bytes_u16,message:bytes_u32; identity and message bytes may be non-UTF8 and LOSSY_ENCODING reports that a bridge substituted text |
| `log_path_record` | entry_kind:u8,object_present:u8,reserved:u16=0,mode:u32,optional object:ObjectId,path:bytes_u32 containing non-root FS WirePath; emitted immediately after its CommitRecord when LOG_PATH_OIDS is requested; absence means the followed path is deleted at that commit and requires entry_kind=BLOB,mode=0 |
| `tree_entry_record` | entry_kind:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,mode:u32,name:bytes_u16,object:ObjectId |
| `content_record` | object:ObjectId,byte_len:u64,offset:u64,next_offset:u64,delivery:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0; delivered length is next_offset-offset and next_offset<=byte_len; INLINE bytes:bytes_u32 bounded by MAX_INLINE_BYTES and exact delivered length; TRANSFER descriptor:bytes_u32 containing sensitive server-to-client BYTE TransferDescriptor and the sender sends exactly the delivered length before CLOSE; BLOB and PATCH use distinct content kinds |
| `diff_record` | status:u8,similarity_percent:u8,flags:u16,old_path:bytes_u32 empty or FS WirePath,new_path:bytes_u32 empty or FS WirePath,old_mode:u32,new_mode:u32,old_object_present:u8,new_object_present:u8,reserved:u16=0,optional old_object:ObjectId,optional new_object:ObjectId; BINARY,SUBMODULE,FILTERED preserve diff classification |
| `patch_file_record` | status:u8,similarity_percent:u8,flags:u16,old_path:bytes_u32 empty or non-root FS WirePath,new_path:bytes_u32 empty or non-root FS WirePath; begins a structured file section and preserves added/modified/deleted/renamed/copied plus BINARY/FILTERED; at least one path is nonempty |
| `patch_row_record` | old_line:u32,new_line:u32,old_text:bytes_u32,new_text:bytes_u32,old_span_count:u16,reserved:u16=0,repeated old_span:{start:u32,length:u32},new_span_count:u16,reserved:u16=0,repeated new_span:{start:u32,length:u32}; line numbers are one-based and zero means that side is absent; at least one side exists; spans are sorted, non-overlapping byte ranges bounded by their side's text and capped by MAX_PATCH_SPANS |
| `patch_gap_record` | old_line:u32,new_line:u32; hunk elision/cursor coordinates, one-based with at least one nonzero |
| `patch_base_record` | object:ObjectId; effective merge base used for the structured patch |
| `index_entry_record` | stage:u8,status:u8,flags:u16,path:bytes_u32 containing non-root FS WirePath,mode:u32,size:u64,modified_unix_ns:i64,object:ObjectId; stage is 0..3 and flags preserve conflicted,intent-to-add,skip-worktree |
| `discovery_record` | flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,object_algorithm:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,worktree_path:bytes_u32 raw platform bytes empty iff BARE,git_dir:bytes_u32 nonempty raw canonical platform bytes; results are deduplicated by git_dir |
| `blame_record` | flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,start_line:u32 one-based,end_line_exclusive:u32,original_start_line:u32 one-based,commit:ObjectId,original_path:bytes_u32 containing FS WirePath empty only when unchanged,author:bytes_u16,summary:bytes_u16 |
| `reflog_record` | flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,index:u64,old_object:ObjectId,new_object:ObjectId,committer:bytes_u16,committed_unix_seconds:i64,timezone_minutes:i16,reserved:u16=0,message:bytes_u32 |
| `worktree_record` | flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,path:bytes_u32 raw platform bytes empty iff BARE,head_present:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,optional head:ObjectId,branch:bytes_u16 full ref name empty iff DETACHED or BARE,lock_reason:string_u16 empty unless LOCKED |
| `fetch_ref_result` | flags:u16,status:u16,old_present:u8,new_present:u8,reserved:u16=0,optional old:ObjectId,optional new:ObjectId,name:bytes_u16,detail:string_u16; PRUNED requires no new object, NEW requires no old object, status uses Core status codes |
| `entity_record` | entity_kind:u16,reserved:u16=0,key:bytes_u16,entity_revision:u64,body:bytes_u32 containing exact EntityBody,Extensions; ADD and REPLACE use the complete record; HEAD key is ASCII HEAD, OPERATION key is ASCII operation, REF/REMOTE/UPSTREAM keys are their raw nonempty names, STATUS key is an encoded non-root FS WirePath, STASH key is its little-endian u32 index, WORKTREE_GENERATION key is ASCII worktrees |
| `head_entity_body` | flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,object_present:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,optional object:ObjectId,symbolic_target:bytes_u16; DETACHED requires object and empty target, UNBORN requires no object and nonempty target, otherwise object and nonempty target |
| `ref_entity_body` | flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,object:ObjectId,peeled_present:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,optional peeled:ObjectId,symbolic_target:bytes_u16; PEELED and SYMBOLIC flags exactly match optional peeled and nonempty target |
| `remote_entity_body` | flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,fetch_url:bytes_u32,push_url:bytes_u32; URLs are raw configured bytes, each bounded by MAX_REMOTE_BYTES, and push_url is empty when equal to fetch_url |
| `operation_entity_body` | operation_kind:u8,flags:u8,reserved:u16=0,head_present:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,optional head:ObjectId,detail:string_u16; HEAD_PRESENT exactly matches the optional object |
| `status_entity_body` | index_status:u8,worktree_status:u8,flags:u16,content_present:u8,old_path_present:u8,reserved:u16=0,optional content:ObjectId,optional old_path:bytes_u32 containing non-root FS WirePath; CONTENT_PRESENT and OLD_PATH_PRESENT flags exactly match their optional values; current path is the EntityRecord key |
| `upstream_entity_body` | flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,ahead:u32,behind:u32,upstream:bytes_u16; EntityRecord key is the local branch's full ref name; GONE requires zero counts and forbids COUNTS_VALID, otherwise COUNTS_VALID says ahead/behind are complete under the walk budget |
| `stash_entity_body` | object:ObjectId,created_unix_seconds:i64,timezone_minutes:i16,reserved:u16=0,message:bytes_u32; EntityRecord key is the little-endian u32 N of stash@{N} |
| `worktree_generation_entity_body` | count:u32,reserved:u32=0,digest:u64; the order-independent worktree-set generation; EntityRecord key is ASCII worktrees and clients refetch QUERY WORKTREES whenever count or digest changes |
| `entity_patch` | entity_kind:u16,reserved:u16=0,key:bytes_u16,observed_revision:u64,fields:u32,replacement:bytes_u32 containing complete EntityRecord with identical kind/key,Extensions |
| `removed_entity` | entity_kind:u16,reserved:u16=0,key:bytes_u16,removed_revision:u64 |
| `family_limits` | ordered optional extensions: tags 1..10 encode max repositories/session:u32,watches/repository:u32,watched queries/repository:u32,query records:u32,query bytes:u32,cursor bytes:u32,spec bytes:u32,inline bytes:u32,concurrent queries:u32,concurrent fetches:u32 |

## `yas.lsp` (`0x0032`/v1)

### Requests

| Kind | Name | Direction | Sensitive | Compression | Datagram | Required layout |
| ---: | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `0x0000` | `OPEN` | `client_to_server` | `required` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | source:bytes_u32 containing WorkspaceSource,open_mode:u8,reserved:u8=0,diagnostics_settle_ms:u16,language:string_u16,profile:string_u16,initialization_options:bytes_u32,Extensions; EXPLICIT requires nonempty language/profile and permits initialization options; AUTO_DISCOVER requires all three empty and may start multiple backends; ResultPrefix + workspace_handle:u64,workspace_revision:u64,position_encoding:u8,reserved:u8=0,backend_count:u16,capabilities:u64,canonical_root:bytes_u32 raw platform bytes,Extensions; backend_count zero requires OPEN_NO_BACKEND_DETAIL_EXTENSION |
| `0x0001` | `CLOSE` | `client_to_server` | `required` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | workspace_handle:u64,Extensions; ResultPrefix; idempotent and releases workspace-scoped watches |
| `0x0002` | `WATCH` | `client_to_server` | `required` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | workspace_handle:u64,datasets:u16,reserved:u16=0,state:bytes_u32 containing StateWatch; ResultPrefix + StateWatchResult |
| `0x0003` | `UNWATCH` | `client_to_server` | `required` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | subscription_id:u32; ResultPrefix |
| `0x0004` | `QUERY` | `client_to_server` | `required` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | workspace_handle:u64,max_records:u16,reserved:u16=0,cursor:bytes_u16,initial_receive_credit:u64,body:bytes_u32 containing QueryBody,Extensions; ResultPrefix + QueryPage |
| `0x0005` | `BUFFER_PUT` | `client_to_server` | `required` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | workspace_handle:u64,operation_id:[u8;16],expected_revision:u64,path:bytes_u32 containing FS WirePath,content:bytes_u32 containing valid UTF-8 document text,Extensions; expected revision zero requires absent overlay; ResultPrefix + BufferIdentity |
| `0x0006` | `BUFFER_BEGIN` | `client_to_server` | `required` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | workspace_handle:u64,expected_revision:u64,path:bytes_u32 containing FS WirePath,byte_len:u64,content_hash:[u8;32],initial_send_credit:u64,Extensions; ResultPrefix + staging_handle:u64,descriptor:bytes_u32 containing sensitive receiver-to-sender BYTE TransferDescriptor with required upload-stage extension naming that handle,Extensions; staged bytes must be valid UTF-8 document text when BUFFER_COMMIT validates them; before BUFFER_COMMIT succeeds, RESET of the returned descriptor discards the stage |
| `0x0007` | `BUFFER_COMMIT` | `client_to_server` | `required` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | staging_handle:u64,operation_id:[u8;16],Extensions; validates exact size, hash, and UTF-8 before publishing; ResultPrefix + BufferIdentity |
| `0x0008` | `BUFFER_CLOSE` | `client_to_server` | `required` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | buffer_handle:u64,expected_revision:u64,operation_id:[u8;16],Extensions; ResultPrefix |
| `0x0009` | `LIST_SERVERS` | `client_to_server` | `required` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | workspace_handle:u64,Extensions; zero workspace lists all session-visible servers; ResultPrefix + ServerList |
| `0x000a` | `STOP_SERVER` | `client_to_server` | `required` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | server_handle:u64,generation:u64,operation_id:[u8;16],Extensions; ResultPrefix; idempotent by operation ID |

Every Request kind has a correlated Result with the same family and kind.

### Events

| Kind | Name | Direction | Sensitive | Compression | Datagram | Required layout |
| ---: | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `0x0000` | `STATE` | `server_to_client` | `required` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | StateEvent<StateEntity\|EntityPatch\|RemovedEntity>; entities are BACKEND, DIAGNOSTICS, and BUFFER |
| `0x0001` | `STATE_ACK` | `client_to_server` | `allowed` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | StateAck |
| `0x0002` | `CLOSED` | `server_to_client` | `required` | `allowed` | `forbidden` | workspace_handle:u64,reason:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,detail:string_u32; reason is CLIENT_REQUEST,ROOT_GONE,PERMISSION_LOST,BACKEND_FAILED,or RESOURCE_LIMIT; connection loss is a local client lifecycle reason, not a wire Event |

### Shared types

| Name | Required layout |
| --- | --- |
| `workspace_source` | kind:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0; FS root_handle:u64,root_path:bytes_u32 containing FS WirePath; PLATFORM_PATH path:bytes_u32 raw nonempty platform bytes; TERMINAL_CWD terminal_handle:u64,suffix:bytes_u32 containing relative FS WirePath resolved atomically from that terminal's live cwd |

| `query_body` | kind:u16,flags:u16=0,variant body; DEFINITION target+position; REFERENCES target+position+query_flags:u16+reserved:u16; HOVER target+position; DOCUMENT_SYMBOLS target; WORKSPACE_SYMBOLS query:string_u16; COMPLETION target+position+trigger_kind:u8+reserved:[u8;3]+trigger:string_u16; CODE_ACTIONS target+range+diagnostic_count:u16+reserved:u16+ids:u64; FORMATTING target+range_present:u8+reserved:[u8;3]+optional range+tab_width:u16+format_flags:u16; RENAME target+position+new_name:string_u16; SIGNATURE_HELP target+position |

| `query_page` | query_status:u16,page_flags:u16,detail:string_u32,next_cursor:bytes_u16,total_hint:u64,delivery:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0; query_status uses Core status codes, non-OK requires INCOMPLETE and nonempty detail, OK requires empty detail; TRUNCATED iff next_cursor is nonempty; INLINE record_count:u16,reserved:u16=0,record_stream:bytes_u32; TRANSFER descriptor:bytes_u32 containing sensitive server-to-client MESSAGE TransferDescriptor; Extensions; a Core non-OK Result still has no body |
| `location_record` | path:bytes_u32 containing non-root FS WirePath,document_revision:u64,content_hash:[u8;32] BLAKE3-256,range:TextRange,flags:u16,reserved:u16=0 |
| `hover_record` | target:bytes_u32 containing LocationRecord,markup_kind:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,content:bytes_u32; target supplies exact path/hash/revision/range |
| `symbol_record` | symbol_kind:u16,flags:u16,depth:u16,reserved:u16=0,name:string_u16,detail:string_u16,path:bytes_u32 empty or FS WirePath,content_hash_present:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,optional content_hash:[u8;32] required exactly when path is present,range:TextRange,selection_range:TextRange |
| `completion_record` | item_kind:u16,flags:u16,label:string_u16,detail:string_u16,filter_text:string_u16,insert_text:bytes_u32,replacement_range_present:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,optional replacement_range:TextRange |
| `edit_record` | path:bytes_u32 containing non-root FS WirePath,expected_revision:u64,expected_content_hash:[u8;32] BLAKE3-256,range:TextRange,replacement:bytes_u32; both revision and hash are checked atomically |
| `action_record` | title:string_u16,kind:string_u16,flags:u16,edit_count:u16,repeated edit:bytes_u32 containing EditRecord,disabled_reason:string_u32; v1 actions carry edits and never an opaque server command |
